items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: And I remember it was me, Jay Leonhart, John Bunch, I forget who else. Small band.

ctx.x: John Bunch — he used to get nervous when he was on a jingle. He’d get nervous. And I remember it was me, Jay Leonhart, John Bunch, I forget who else. Small band. And Jay Leonhart did the same thing to John Bunch. He said, “Just play the way you play, man, don’t let them —” you know they were asking him for things to do and he was getting nervous. Because John usually, you know he didn’t do a lot of recording, he just did all © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
beautiful gigs you know, beautiful recordings with good singers. But Jay Leonhart saved him. I remember Jay, he says, “Hey man, just play, you know, don’t listen to them.”
